summary: The filing is an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events announcing the appointment of Annamaria Vitelli as EVP, Chief Wealth Officer of Provident Bank and President of Beacon Trust, effective June 1, 2026. This is a routine executive hire and does not involve a corporate event such as a merger, acquisition, activist campaign, or capital restructuring. There are no transaction terms, shareholder votes, or advisors mentioned. The filing simply reports a management-level appointment to lead wealth management growth. No special-situation classification applies.
